newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates ease as rev repo deals mature.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates ease as rev repo deals mature.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates fell on Monday as funds from maturing one-week reverse repo deals boosted market liquidity, dealers said.
Overnight rates opened at 24.5 percent, already down from Friday's 25.00/26.00 percent close, and finished at a bid of 23.00.
"(Money from) one week repos returned," said ABN-Amro's Adam Szilagyi.
At the end of last year substantial funds were placed in one-week reverse repo deals at 21.75 percent as the interest then offered on the overnight market was low.
Dealers saw liquidity on the overnight money market easing further this week, and said overnight rates were likely to drop to the reverse repo level of 21.75 percent on Tuesday or Wednesday.
